objective: Diagnosticar residuos monetarios por ticket del 01/07/2026 en las tres unidades SoftRestaurant con detalle bloqueado. Solo lectura POS.

queries.name: 130mid_20260701_rounding
queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT ch.folio,
         CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS encabezado
  FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
  WHERE tr.apertura >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND tr.apertura < '2026-07-02 00:00:00'
    AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
),
l AS (
  SELECT h.folio,
         MAX(h.encabezado) AS encabezado,
         CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) AS productos
  FROM h
  LEFT JOIN cheqdet dc WITH (NOLOCK) ON dc.foliodet=h.folio
  GROUP BY h.folio
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS tickets,
  CAST(SUM(encabezado) AS decimal(19,4)) AS encabezado_total,
  CAST(SUM(productos) AS decimal(19,4)) AS productos_total,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(encabezado-productos)<=0.05 THEN productos ELSE encabezado END) AS decimal(19,4)) AS detalle_estimado,
  CAST(SUM(encabezado)-SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(encabezado-productos)<=0.05 THEN productos ELSE encabezado END) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta_estimado,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(encabezado-productos)<=0.05 AND ABS(encabezado-productos)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_residuo_tolerado,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(encabezado-productos)<=0.05 THEN encabezado-productos ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(19,4)) AS suma_residuos_tolerados,
  SUM(CASE WHEN encabezado=0 AND ABS(productos)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_cero_con_detalle
FROM l
